summary: A single clickable row inside a panel-list menu.
description: The Acorn API's coverage table lists 'Panel List Item' separately from 'Panel Item', but there is no upstream distinction: both ids refer to the exact same class (PanelItem) and the exact same customElements.define("panel-item", PanelItem) registration, in the same file as panel-list. There is no separate implementation for panel-list-item; this entry documents the same underlying class as the panel-item id. Corrected kind: PanelItem extends plain HTMLElement (no XUL/MozElementMixin base), so it is modern, matching the panel-item id's own classification of the identical class.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Observed attribute. "checkbox" gives the internal button role="menuitemcheckbox" and an aria-checked reflection; any other value (default "button") gives role="menuitem".

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Observed attribute; get/set property. Toggles the disabled attribute on the internal button.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: get/set property (not in observedAttributes). Only meaningful when type="checkbox"; toggles the checked attribute and the internal button's aria-checked.

attributes.name: accesskey
attributes.description: Observed attribute. Moved onto an internal XUL <label> for display; temporarily cleared while the parent panel-list is closed and restored when it reopens (bug 1588156 workaround).

attributes.name: badge-type
attributes.description: Observed attribute. When set, inserts a <moz-badge type="..."> element right after the label; removed when the attribute is cleared.

attributes.name: submenu
attributes.description: Presence flag (hasAttribute("submenu")), read once in connectedCallback. When present, adds a submenu-icon and a named "submenu" slot for a nested panel-list, and sets has-submenu on the parent panel-list.

attributes.name: aria-haspopup
attributes.description: Observed attribute; forwarded verbatim to the internal button's aria-haspopup.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Text content; read via a MutationObserver and copied into the internal <label> element (the assigned nodes themselves stay hidden).

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Named slot rendered alongside the button, e.g. for a 'Learn more' link next to the item.

slots.name: submenu
slots.description: Named slot, only created when the submenu attribute is present; holds a nested panel-list acting as this item's submenu.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Synthesizes a click on the internal button.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Block-start inset of the badge relative to the item.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-inset-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Inline-start inset of the badge relative to the item.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-size
cssProperties.description: Size of the CSS-only badge dot, set inline on :host([badged]) button::after.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the CSS-only badge dot, set inline to var(--color-accent-primary).

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-border-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the internal button.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Inline-start padding of the internal button (accommodates a leading icon).

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start-offset
cssProperties.description: Added on top of --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start; lets a subclass/consumer nudge the icon-accommodating inline-start padding without overriding the whole value.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The internal label element showing the item's text.
